scope: Actual Worker and Drizzle migrations with an isolated Node SQLite in-memory D1 adapter. No LOCAL_PREVIEW, network calls, live database writes, or website source changes.

checks.name: Anonymous editor access returns 401 and cannot claim the editor account
First authenticated identity is accepted as the sole editor
A second identity is rejected with 403
Owner writes without an Origin are rejected with 403
Owner cross-origin writes are rejected with 403
Journal initializes exactly five sample entries from the actual Worker
CMS creates a durable JSON story and derives its slug from the file path
CMS reads the saved story through the editor and public APIs
Public story rendering escapes title, excerpt, heading, and body HTML
CMS updates an existing story without adding another database row
Draft stories remain editable but are absent from public API, listing, and article routes
CMS deletion removes the test story and restores the five sample entries
Deleted sample stories are not reseeded on subsequent reads
Invalid inquiry data returns 400 without writing inquiry or analytics records
Honeypot inquiries return success but write no database rows
A valid inquiry returns 201 and persists one inquiry plus its submission count
Inquiry limit accepts three per email per hour and returns 429 for the fourth
Contact button clicks are accepted without storing supplied personal fields
Other client analytics actions return 400 without inserting records
Analytics paths containing query-string personal data are rejected
Public inquiry and analytics writes also reject missing or cross-site origins
Final isolated journal state contains five sample stories and no audit story
